Introduction
This document outlines the major 
maintenance procedure P2, which must be carried every 48000 operating 
hour.
The medium EXH Gas, material 15 M03, 
Capacity 48.5 steam per hour
The first draft initiated by eng. Fouad Abd El 
Aziz Fayed, tested by eng. Khamis El Sherif, accepted by general manager eng. Samir Ebed 
Barghous, approved by eng. Mahmoud Saad Mahmoud Balbaa Mahoudia PS head sector, 
and certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sherqawy WDEPC inspection & quality 
control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
Shut down the Boiler.
Disconnect the power supply & rack out the CB.
Put red tag on the Boiler.
The safety dep. must check the isolation and surrounding the work zone.
